review_CONFIG: review the detectron2 lazy config that sets up PACO query evaluation on the LVIS test dataset
summarize_CONFIG: summarize the vit_b_fpn_cascade query eval config which overrides the test dataset and evaluator
run_CONFIG: run the PACO query evaluation config using detectron2 with the LVIS v1 test dataset
test_PACOQueryEvaluator: test the PACOQueryEvaluator configured for the paco_lvis_v1_test dataset in this config
refactor_CONFIG: refactor the query eval config to swap the test dataset or evaluator for a different one
